name: MotherDuck Lite
free_limit: 10 GB storage and 10 Pulse compute CU-hours/month; up to 3 internal active users and 2 service accounts
watch_out: Lite is an ongoing $0 tier with 10 GB storage and 10 hours of Pulse compute/month; a card is not needed. An optional 7-day Business trial is separate and does not terminate the free Lite plan. Customer-facing embedding/redistribution is restricted on Lite; usage beyond Lite included quotas needs a paid plan.
